metadata.note: 1984 US Nissan 300ZX 2+2 (Z31, KHLG-JU), VG30E (2,960 cc, 160 hp at 5,200 rpm), 5-speed manual: a V6, one exhaust valve a cylinder, firing 1-2-3-4-5-6 at even intervals; the tubes from the valves in that order, the right bank (1-3-5) to junction 0 and the left (2-4-6) to junction 1 (Nissan's 1984 300ZX service manual, EM-38). Valve: head 35.0-35.2 mm, taken 35.1 mm; open 252 / 720 = 0.35, from 62 BBDC to 10 ATDC (EM-38, EM-40); the manual gives the cam's height, not the valve's lift, so the diameter is written as it is (an estimate that the lift passes a quarter of it). Exhaust of the non-turbo car (FE-6): a front tube from the two manifolds into one, a catalytic converter, a centre tube and one muffler assembly; K's model shows two tail pipes. Written so: each bank's cast manifold, the tubes 0.30, 0.19 and 0.08 m from the front cylinder to the rear (estimates from the 108 mm bore spacing, the outlet at the rear); the front tube's branches 0.55 m (right) and 0.85 m (left) to where they join (junction 2) (estimates); one tube of 4.45 m from there (an estimate: about 2.5 m of pipe through the converter to the muffler at the tail, 0.3 m for the bends, and 1.65 m within the muffler, three times a 0.55 m body, counted in the tube's length as for the Beetle (K)); two tail pipes of 0.25 m (estimate). No expansion chamber is written. Diameter 0.040 m: the manifold's branch, taken as the valve's 35.1 mm inside, times 1.14 (an estimate). Every length is an estimate: the manual's drawing has no dimensions.
